newsitems.title: Quick demo patch v 0.1.11
newsitems.author: Argl
newsitems.contents: Thanks everybody for all your great feedback and bug report on the demo!Most of you seems to be having a lot of fun, that is awesome news and gives us strength to carry on. We received a tons of people being stuck in ADS, sorry about that, it's really hard to track down and fix. We have made a first attempt but it doesn't fix all instances of the bug, we'll keep digging.﻿CHANGE LOGFallback fonts for cyrlic and asian languagesBetter Shockwave impact on enemiesBUGFixed ADS locked after dying or opening a menu (but the bug can still happens in other unknown situation)Autofire now can't be activated in unproper situation

newsitems.title: Blow up thousands of monsters in the horde-based survivor FPS Guns 'n Goblins
newsitems.contents: Love the idea of powering up yourself to the max while annihilating thousands of monsters? The first-person bullet heaven shooter Guns 'n Goblins is for you. Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2026/05/blow-up-thousands-of-monsters-in-the-horde-based-survivor-fps-guns-n-goblins/
